### F.5 Self-excluding preimages and finalization DAG

| Identifier | Canonical self-excluding preimage | Mandatory exclusions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `publicationCandidateId` | Domain `JAN-CSAA-PUBLICATION-CANDIDATE`; ODP-003; exact `schemaId`, contract ID/version, and record role; canonical `candidateSubjectKey`, P06–P09 exact coordinate values, `memberManifestRef`, `dependencyManifestRef`, `limitationManifestRef`, `validationInputBasisRef`, `staticValidationResults`, `canonicalAggregateDigests`, `legacyManifestStaticProjectionDigest`, `sealedAt`, `securityPartitionRef`, semantic/serialization owners, exact operational-profile instantiation, authorization/access/information-control bindings, `observedAtOrEffectiveAt` equal to `sealedAt`, provenance, evidence, and limitations | `publicationCandidateId`/`roleIdentity`; `recordId`; `recordDigest`; `extensions`; candidate lifecycle identity or state; common predecessor; Publication Manifest identity/record; publication channel; P01–P05 and P10–P12; predicate/state revision; V07 eligibility result; decision/current binding; response; audit completion; health completion; output-complete replay |
| `replayBasisManifestId` | Domain `JAN-CSAA-REPLAY-BASIS`; ODP-004; exact `schemaId`, contract ID/version, record role, `securityPartitionRef`, and `observedAtOrEffectiveAt`; canonical `operationExecutionId`, required `workUnitRef`, required `attemptRef`, every finalized `inputRefs`, `influenceRefs`, `environmentRef`, `profileRefs`, `policyRefs`, `providerMethodRefs`, `omissions`, `allowedDifferences`, semantic/serialization owners, projection coordinates, exact operational-profile instantiation, predecessor-or-not-applicable value, authorization/access/information-control bindings, provenance, evidence, and limitations | `replayBasisManifestId`/`roleIdentity`; `recordId`; `recordDigest`; `extensions`; same-attempt outputs or output-derived observations; candidate lifecycle/content; Publication Manifest; decision; response; audit completion; health completion; output-complete replay |
| `replayManifestId` | Domain `JAN-CSAA-REPLAY-COMPLETION`; ODP-005; exact `schemaId`, contract ID/version, record role, `securityPartitionRef`, and `observedAtOrEffectiveAt`; canonical `replayBasisManifestRef`, `attemptRef`, `actualOutcome`, finalized `outputRefs`, `outputAggregateDigests`, applicable `resultingCandidateLifecycleRef`, `resultingPublicationCandidateRef`, `resultingPublicationManifestRef`, only already-finalized independent `eligibleAuditObservationRefs` and `eligibleHealthObservationRefs`, `allowedDifferenceResults`, semantic/serialization owners, projection coordinates, exact operational-profile instantiation, predecessor-or-not-applicable value, authorization/access/information-control bindings, provenance, evidence, and limitations | `replayManifestId`/`roleIdentity`; `recordId`; `recordDigest`; `extensions`; any same-output candidate, Manifest, output, audit, or health record that directly or transitively depends on this replay identity; resulting Publication Decision; every later response, audit-completion, or health-completion field |

The tables are exhaustive: every envelope and payload field is named in either its row's inclusion or exclusion. An excluded field remains serialized when the envelope requires it but does not enter the content-identifier preimage; an optional or role-not-applicable field follows its ordinary carrier rule. The field being constructed is absent from its preimage, not blank, zeroed, provisionally populated, or backfilled. `recordDigest` is computed only after the content identifier has been installed in `roleIdentity`; it never participates in that identifier's preimage. Every referenced content-bound record is already finalized, and the preimage-reference graph is acyclic. Unequal canonical preimage, profile, purpose domain, contract version, or exclusion treatment yields a different identity or explicit collision/integrity failure.

`legacyManifestStaticProjectionDigest` is exactly ODP-002 over `(candidateSubjectKey, memberManifestRef, dependencyManifestRef, limitationManifestRef, validationInputBasisRef, staticValidationResults, canonicalAggregateDigests)`. This tuple is the complete predecision projection of every preserved §8.6 Publication Manifest field except eligibility outcome, predecessor publication reference, published-or-refused time and reason, and the V07 Publication-eligibility validation-stage result. `candidateSubjectKey` supplies the exact static and optional execution subject; `memberManifestRef` supplies included record-set manifests and counts; `canonicalAggregateDigests` supplies their aggregates; `dependencyManifestRef` supplies schema-package and generated-derivative identities; `staticValidationResults` supplies exactly finalized V01 through V06 results; and `limitationManifestRef` plus the exact member/dependency closures supplies coverage, health, freshness, conflict, partiality, and unsupported summaries. `validationInputBasisRef` binds the inputs against which those results were obtained. Every mapping is equality-checked before the digest or candidate identity is computed. The digest is not a provisional Manifest, record identity, decision, or current binding.

At authoritative decision finalization, `completedLegacyManifestProjectionDigest` is exactly ODP-002 over `(legacyManifestStaticProjectionDigest, publicationEligibilityValidationRef and its exact V07 outcome, exact completed predicate-evaluation outcome, predecessorManifestBinding, decisionBranch, decisionAt, branchReasonCode)`. `publicationEligibilityValidationRef` must target the finalized V07 `ValidationResultRecord` whose subject/input basis, outcome, and cutoff equal the candidate and complete predicate evaluation. `predecessorManifestBinding` is `existing { predecessorDecisionRef, predecessorManifestRef }` or `explicit-none { noneReason }`. The existing branch requires the unique already-finalized lifecycle successor that paired the expected predecessor decision with its branch-complete legacy Manifest; its Manifest reference is the preserved legacy predecessor-publication reference. The explicit-none branch is permitted only for the proven initial no-binding case. A predecessor decision without that exact pair-binding successor is not Manifest-ready and cannot be the basis of another publication attempt.

The completed projection digest is serialized in the authoritative decision and therefore joins the sealed candidate's entire static Manifest meaning with every decision-time Manifest field at the linearization fact. It is not the future legacy record identity or record digest. The exact authoritative physical current binding is the key/value pair `bindingKey=(securityPartitionId, publicationChannelId)` and `bindingValue=(resultingPublicationGeneration, publicationDecisionRef, publicationCandidateRef, completedLegacyManifestProjectionDigest)`. `securityPartitionId` is the exact P01-P02 digest and `publicationChannelId` is the exact P03-P05 digest. The key's security partition must equal the candidate-lifecycle `securityPartitionId` and the security-partition value bound by both the referenced candidate's and decision's common-envelope `securityPartitionRef`; the key's channel must equal the lifecycle and decision channels. The complete key and value advance atomically on the published branch; no cross-partition channel alias, incomplete value, provisional value, or postcommit-filled binding is admitted. References in `JAN-CSAA-009` to the otherwise circular predecision Publication Manifest identity/digest are represented by the sealed candidate plus `legacyManifestStaticProjectionDigest` before comparison and by the decision's `completedLegacyManifestProjectionDigest` at and after decision. This is the exact noncircular alternative required by `JAN-CSAA-009` §7.1; it preserves all Manifest semantics in the authoritative binding without anticipating a future legacy record.

Because the legacy Manifest requires branch facts, no `PublicationManifestRecord` exists before an authoritative `PublicationDecisionRecord`. After that decision finalizes, exactly one branch-complete legacy Manifest is completed from the static projection, exact completed predicate evaluation, exact predecessor-Manifest mapping, and exact decision. Its complete preserved §8.6 semantic projection must reproduce `completedLegacyManifestProjectionDigest`. The Manifest is finalized once and is never provisional, blank-filled, rewritten, or backfilled. `SEALED`, `ELIGIBLE`, `COMMITTING`, and `COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` lifecycle revisions bind no legacy Manifest. A later published or postcomparison-refused lifecycle successor binds both the finalized decision and Manifest. A predecision refusal, abandonment, or quarantine binds neither and produces no legacy Manifest.

The publication order is exact:

1. Finalize subject, dependencies, members, profiles, policies, and optional `ReplayBasisManifestRecord`.
2. Persist pre-seal lifecycle revisions carrying only `candidateLifecycleId` and phase-valid control state.
3. Compute `publicationCandidateId` from its self-excluding canonical preimage, including `legacyManifestStaticProjectionDigest`.
4. Finalize `PublicationCandidateRecord` without legacy Manifest, lifecycle, decision, current-binding, response, audit-completion, health-completion, or output-complete replay dependency.
5. Append the `SEALED` successor binding the candidate alone; persist exact predicate-evaluation revisions and, when proceeding, append `ELIGIBLE` and `COMMITTING` revisions with durable intent and the exact comparison guard.
6. Execute the fenced authoritative comparison only after all five payload guard values, their P12 projection, observed current binding, active fencing right, and predecessor-Manifest mapping are proven coherent. A proven successful branch atomically finalizes `PublicationDecisionRecord(decision=published)` with `completedLegacyManifestProjectionDigest`, mints `publicationCommitId`, records D5 `linearizationEvidenceRef`, and advances the complete physical binding plus generation as one linearization fact. A proven no-commit comparison may finalize `PublicationDecisionRecord(decision=refused)` with its completed projection digest, exact refusal evidence, and no binding mutation. An outcome-unknown branch records `COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` without a decision record or `publicationCommitId`.
7. Only after a decision finalizes, materialize the legacy Manifest from the static projection, predicate evaluation, predecessor-Manifest mapping, and decision; require its full semantic projection to reproduce `completedLegacyManifestProjectionDigest`; then append the later lifecycle successor binding candidate, decision, and Manifest. A predecision terminal disposition and an outcome-unknown branch produce neither Manifest nor pair-binding successor.
8. Only after the required Manifest/lifecycle binding exists may Manifest-dependent read acquisition, branch-consistent response, reconstructable audit, and non-authoritative current-binding projection proceed. The authoritative binding is already semantically complete through its completed projection digest, but it remains unavailable to legacy-Manifest-dependent content reads until deterministic compatibility materialization is proven.
9. Create any later output-complete `ReplayManifestRecord`.

Reverse references are derived. No pre-seal revision is rewritten. A current-binding response projection is non-authoritative and never absorbs channel, candidate, decision, or generation identity. Only `ReplayBasisManifestRecord` may occur in candidate basis; later `ReplayManifestRecord` can reference the candidate but cannot become its dependency.

The six independently testable conditions are allocated exactly:

| 009 case | Wire defect | Required rejection |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-TST-PHASE-001` | `ABSENT` or `ASSEMBLING` lifecycle revision contains `publicationCandidateId` | Phase-invalid; no publication or historical rewrite |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-TST-PHASE-002` | Post-seal action backfills a pre-seal lifecycle revision | Immutable-history and integrity failure |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-TST-PHASE-003` | One `candidateLifecycleId` is rebound to different sealed content | Lifecycle collision; original terminal lineage preserved |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-TST-PHASE-004` | Content identifier is blanked, zeroed, provisional, or self-inclusive in its preimage | Noncanonical or circular identity construction |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-TST-PHASE-005` | Replay-basis preimage includes same-attempt output or output-derived completion | Future-dependent or circular basis |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-TST-PHASE-006` | Replay-completion preimage directly or transitively includes material depending on the same replay identity | Cyclic completion identity; later correlations remain outside the preimage |

Each case is independently executable and independently reported by the affected 008 successor. Passing one cannot satisfy another, and an ordinary success path cannot mask a failure.

---

### F.6 Read vectors, operation correlation, and current binding

`PublicationVector` is an ordered nonempty collection of the exact closed shape below:

```text
PublicationLaneBinding {
  laneOrdinal:Count
  laneKind=static|execution
  laneId:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
  securityPartitionId:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
  publicationDecisionRef:OperationalContentBoundRef<PublicationDecisionRecord>
  publicationManifestRef:ContentBoundRecordRef<PublicationManifestRecord>
  publicationChannelId:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
  publicationGeneration:Generation
  executionEvidenceBinding=
    exact {
      executionEvidenceSetIdentityRef:
        ContentBoundRecordRef<ExecutionEvidenceSetIdentityRecord>,
      executionEvidenceSetRevision:Revision
    } |
    source-owned-not-applicable {
      ownerRef:AuthorityRef, reasonCode:PermanentId,
      explanation:NonEmptyString, basisRefs:1..*
    }
  staticSemanticSnapshotIdentityRef:
    ContentBoundRecordRef<StaticSemanticSnapshotIdentityRecord>
  observationCutoff:Timestamp
  authorizationDecisionRef:ContentBoundRecordRef<AccessDecisionRecord>
  policyRefs:
    OperationalCollection<OperationalReference(refKind=policy),
                          SET_CANONICAL, OCK-005>[1..*]
}
```

The collection is keyed by OCK-008. `laneId` is exactly `digest(ODP-002, laneKind, publicationDecisionRef, publicationManifestRef, executionEvidenceBinding, staticSemanticSnapshotIdentityRef)`, `securityPartitionId` is the exact P01-P02 digest, and `publicationChannelId` is the exact P03-P05 digest; each digest uses the complete `DigestDescriptor`. `laneId` is a derived vector-entry projection, not a caller-selected or independently registered operational identity. `laneOrdinal` is contiguous from zero and is part of OCK-008; a different ordinal is a different vector projection.

Every lane is referentially closed. `publicationDecisionRef` targets a finalized `decision=published` record whose `publicationChannelId` and `resultingPublicationGeneration` equal the lane's `publicationChannelId` and `publicationGeneration`. That decision's `candidateLifecycleRef` targets the exact finalized predecision lifecycle revision that binds the sealed candidate, has the lane's `securityPartitionId`, and prohibits a legacy Manifest; its `publicationCandidateRef` names that candidate. The candidate and decision common-envelope security partitions equal the lifecycle and lane partition. A later successor in the same lifecycle, finalized after the decision and legacy Manifest, binds `publicationDecisionRef` and `publicationManifestRef`. The lane is valid only when its decision/Manifest pair is exactly the pair bound by that later successor; the Manifest's static projection reproduces the candidate's `legacyManifestStaticProjectionDigest`, its predecessor reference follows the exact predecessor-decision-to-predecessor-Manifest mapping, its eligibility/branch/time/reason reproduce the exact predicate evaluation and decision, and its complete semantic projection reproduces the decision's `completedLegacyManifestProjectionDigest`. The decision never references its future Manifest or future lifecycle successor.

A static lane requires `executionEvidenceBinding=source-owned-not-applicable` with nonempty basis and its candidate subject's static snapshot must equal `staticSemanticSnapshotIdentityRef`. An execution lane requires the `exact` branch and the exact published evidence-set identity/revision, whose source-owned static snapshot equals `staticSemanticSnapshotIdentityRef`. `authorizationDecisionRef` must be an allowing or exact allow-with-redaction decision for that lane, and the nonempty `policyRefs` must be the exact evaluated policy-contract set at `observationCutoff`, which cannot precede the decision. A mismatch in decision branch, candidate, Manifest, channel, generation, evidence branch or revision, static snapshot, authorization, policy, cutoff, or derived `laneId` invalidates the complete vector rather than degrading to an apparently committed lane. The authoritative physical binding is already complete through its decision-carried Manifest projection, but no legacy-Manifest-dependent content-read lane is admissible until the later pair-binding successor exists.

P11 `compatibilityPairs` uses the following exact closed shapes:

```text
CompatibilityEndpoint =
  publication-lane {
    endpointKind=publication-lane,
    laneOrdinal:Count,
    laneId:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002),
    publicationDecisionRef:OperationalContentBoundRef<PublicationDecisionRecord>,
    laneContractSurface=decision|candidate|legacy-manifest,
    contractArtifactDescriptorRef:
      ContentBoundRecordRef<ContractArtifactDescriptorRecord>,
    contractRef:ContractRef
  } |
  contract-artifact-consumer {
    endpointKind=contract-artifact-consumer,
    consumerDeclarationRef:
      ContentBoundRecordRef<ContractArtifactDescriptorRecord>,
    contractRef:ContractRef
  } |
  adapter-consumer {
    endpointKind=adapter-consumer,
    consumerDeclarationRef:
      ContentBoundRecordRef<AdapterDescriptorRecord>,
    contractRef:ContractRef
  }

CompatibilityComparedSurfaceProjection {
  digestProfileSurfaceDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
  identityReferenceSurfaceDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
  envelopeAssignmentSurfaceDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
  collectionSurfaceDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
  recursiveDefinitionSurfaceDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
  objectRelationSurfaceDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
  operationPolicySurfaceDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
  typedErrorSurfaceDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
  extensionSurfaceDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
  purposeProjectionSurfaceDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
}

CompatibilityPairBinding {
  pairOrdinal:Count
  sourceEndpoint:CompatibilityEndpoint
  targetEndpoint:CompatibilityEndpoint
  sourceEndpointDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
  targetEndpointDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
  compatibilityRef:
    ContentBoundRecordRef<CompatibilityClaimRecord>
  direction=backward|forward|bidirectional
  scopeProjection {
    sourceContractRef:ContractRef,
    targetContractRef:ContractRef,
    sourceSemanticOwnerRefs:
      OperationalCollection<ContractRef, SET_CANONICAL, ECK-004>[1..*],
    targetSemanticOwnerRefs:
      OperationalCollection<ContractRef, SET_CANONICAL, ECK-004>[1..*],
    assumptionRefs:
      OperationalCollection<
        OperationalReference(refKind=operational-content|legacy-content|policy|artifact),
        SET_CANONICAL, OCK-005>[0..*],
    comparedSurfaceProjection:CompatibilityComparedSurfaceProjection,
    comparedSurfaceDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002),
    usePurposeRef:ContractRef
  }
  scopeDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
  result=compatible|compatible-with-bounded-loss
  semanticLossTreatment=
    none-demonstrated |
    bounded-disclosed { lossManifestRef:OperationalReference }
  evidenceRefs:
    OperationalCollection<
      OperationalReference(refKind=operational-content|legacy-content|artifact),
      SET_CANONICAL, OCK-005>[1..*]
  authorRef:AuthorityRef
  reviewRefs:
    OperationalCollection<AuthorityRef, SET_CANONICAL, ECK-007>[1..*]
  validity {
    validFrom:Timestamp,
    validUntil?:Timestamp,
    invalidationRefs:
      OperationalCollection<
        ContentBoundRecordRef<InvalidationRecord>,
        SET_CANONICAL, ECK-003>[0..*]
  }
  compatibilityUseProjectionDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
}
```

Each top-level endpoint digest is exactly ODP-002 over its selected closed endpoint branch. A `publication-lane` endpoint is registered only when its ordinal, lane ID, and decision reference equal one exact member of the containing P11 `observedPublicationVector`. `laneContractSurface` then selects exactly one carrier: `decision` selects that lane's decision, `candidate` selects that decision's exact `publicationCandidateRef`, and `legacy-manifest` selects that lane's exact `publicationManifestRef`. `contractArtifactDescriptorRef` must be the finalized package descriptor for the selected carrier's exact record role, schema ID, contract family, contract version, and contract content digest, and its described `ContractRef` equals the endpoint `contractRef`. Thus the operational decision/candidate family and preserved legacy Manifest family cannot be conflated.

A `contract-artifact-consumer` endpoint's declaration targets the exact finalized `ContractArtifactDescriptorRecord` whose described `ContractRef` equals its endpoint `contractRef`; its endpoint kind is the fixed consumer-role discriminator and no undeclared `consumerRole` scalar exists. An `adapter-consumer` endpoint's declaration targets the exact finalized `AdapterDescriptorRecord`, and its endpoint `contractRef` must be one exact member of that adapter's declared supported-contract population for the use. Operation requests are excluded because their ordinary envelope contract does not by itself declare the semantic contract they can interpret. No caller-selected endpoint, bare role string, unrelated descriptor, or undeclared contract is admitted. OCK-011 keys the resulting ordered pair without dereference.

Each member of `CompatibilityComparedSurfaceProjection` is exactly ODP-002 over `(surfaceId, sourceContractRef, sourceSurfaceProjection, targetContractRef, targetSurfaceProjection)`, where the two surface projections are the canonically ordered complete registered values for that named surface. The ten surface IDs and their contents are fixed: digest profiles; identity/reference kinds and directions; envelope assignments; collection modes, keys, and cardinalities; recursive-definition registry and budgets; object/relation shapes; operation/request/response policy; typed-error codes and safe payloads; extension behavior; and purpose projections. `comparedSurfaceDigest` is exactly ODP-002 over the complete closed `CompatibilityComparedSurfaceProjection` in that field order. Omission, an aggregate without all ten components, a caller-supplied digest with no reproduced component projections, or a source/target contract mismatch is invalid.

`scopeDigest` is exactly ODP-002 over the closed `scopeProjection`, whose source/target contracts equal the endpoint contracts, whose source/target semantic-owner `ContractRef` populations equal the claim's exact semantic-owner versions, whose assumptions equal the claim's exact assumption population, and whose compared-surface digest reproduces its nested projection. `compatibilityUseProjectionDigest` is exactly ODP-002 over `(compatibilityRef, sourceEndpointDigest, targetEndpointDigest, direction, scopeDigest, result, semanticLossTreatment, evidenceRefs, authorRef, reviewRefs, validity)`. `compatibilityRef` targets only a finalized `CompatibilityClaimRecord`, in accordance with `JAN-CSAA-007-EOT-P-015` and `JAN-CSAA-009` P11. That claim's exact source/target contracts and semantic-owner versions, direction, scope, assumptions, ten-part compared surface, successful result, semantic-loss state and loss manifest, evidence, distinct author and reviewer population, effective/expiry boundary, and invalidations must project to the serialized pair fields and reproduce both `scopeDigest` and `compatibilityUseProjectionDigest`. `authorRef` equals the claim author; `reviewRefs` equals the complete nonempty reviewer population and does not absorb or infer the author. The content-bound `compatibilityRef` participates in the use digest, so two claim records differing only in assumptions, ownership, authorship, review, time, or invalidation cannot collide as one use projection. A `CompatibilityDecisionRecord`, inline Boolean/result, compatibility map, structural similarity, or singular aggregate reference cannot satisfy this alias. `result` values outside the two successful branches, unresolved/prohibited loss, missing review/evidence, expired validity, or a projection mismatch are invalid.

P11 carries exactly one binding for every directed cross-version or cross-lane pair actually combined, traversed, transformed, or interpreted and one consumer endpoint for every lane-to-consumer version boundary. A missing pair, duplicate logical endpoint/direction pair, reversed direction, or unregistered endpoint is invalid even if `pairOrdinal` or the referenced record differs. One bidirectional decision may cover both directions only when its exact claim is bidirectional and its scope covers both; otherwise two directed bindings are required. An exact empty collection is valid only when no cross-version, cross-lane, or lane-to-consumer boundary exists.

Whenever P11 is `exact-value`, `observedPublicationVector` is exactly `OperationalCollection<PublicationLaneBinding, ORDERED, OCK-008>` with contiguous zero-based `laneOrdinal`, complete OCK-008 keys, and no duplicate. For candidate-form P07 it equals exactly `committedUpstreamLanes`; for read-form P07 it equals exactly `committedLanes`; another operation-specific exact P07 projection must name and equal the same phase-correct committed-lane population. If P07 is owner-backed not-applicable, P11 cannot serialize an observed vector and must follow its own applicability rule rather than fabricate an empty observation. An exact empty P11 vector is valid only for an applicable operation with a proven empty committed-lane population.

`validFrom <= acquisitionCutoff`, `validUntil` is absent or not earlier than that cutoff, and no carried invalidation is effective at or before it. For a `ContentReadViewRecord`, every pair's validity is established at the common `acquisitionCutoff`; P11 `observedPublicationVector` equals the complete P07 read vector. A compatibility map, structural similarity, singular aggregate reference without pair coverage, or same-major assumption cannot satisfy the collection.

`ContentReadViewRecord.currentBindingObservation` is exactly one required inline branch. Its material current-binding entries use the following closed shape:

```text
CurrentPhysicalBindingEntry {
  laneOrdinal:Count
  securityPartitionId:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
  publicationChannelId:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
  publicationGeneration:Generation
  publicationDecisionRef:OperationalContentBoundRef<PublicationDecisionRecord>
  publicationCandidateRef:OperationalContentBoundRef<PublicationCandidateRecord>
  completedLegacyManifestProjectionDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002)
}

current-binding {
  observationCutoff:Timestamp,
  observedPublicationVectorDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002),
  observedPhysicalBindings:
    OperationalCollection<
      CurrentPhysicalBindingEntry, ORDERED, OCK-012>[1..*],
  observationBasisRefs:1..*
} |
explicitly-historical {
  observationCutoff:Timestamp,
  observedPublicationVectorDigest:DigestDescriptor(profile=ODP-002),
  observationBasisRefs:1..*
}
```

The content-bound `ContentReadViewRecord` itself is the material acquisition observation; this inline value participates in its `recordDigest` and creates no new role or identity. Its `observationCutoff` equals `acquisitionCutoff`, ContentReadView P12 `acquisitionCutoff` is mandatory exact-value and equals both, and `publicationVectorDigest` is exactly `digest(ODP-002, acquisitionCutoff, canonical ordered PublicationVector)`. `observedPublicationVectorDigest` equals that digest. The nonempty observation basis proves the entire vector in one logical acquisition observation; independently timed lane observations cannot be stitched together and called common. The `current-binding` collection has exactly one entry for each publication-vector lane, in the same `laneOrdinal` order, and no other entry. The `explicitly-historical` branch is closed and prohibits `observedPhysicalBindings`.

Every decision time, lane observation cutoff, authorization/policy validity cutoff, and required integrity/availability evidence cutoff is no later than the common acquisition cutoff; a lane cutoff need not equal it. `current-binding` requires every authoritative physical binding at that cutoff to equal the corresponding lane-derived complete key/value tuple simultaneously: `securityPartitionId`, `publicationChannelId`, `publicationGeneration`, `publicationDecisionRef`, the decision's exact `publicationCandidateRef`, and the decision's exact `completedLegacyManifestProjectionDigest`. Each material entry serializes those six values, and every value equals both the authoritative binding and the referentially closed lane/decision expectation; matching only channel, generation, or decision is insufficient. `explicitly-historical` requires every lane at that same cutoff to remain committed, retained, available, integrity-valid, pairwise compatible, and separately authorized for historical use and confers no currentness. Any absent, unavailable, corrupt, outcome-unknown, incompatible, unauthorized, or mismatched lane makes the complete acquisition unavailable and no `ContentReadViewRecord` or `readViewId` is minted.

Candidate P07 and read P07 are different closed variants. The candidate variant carries the new evidence-set identity/revision and source-owned static snapshot plus already committed upstream lanes, and excludes its own future decision and generation. The read variant carries committed decision/Manifest/channel/generation for every lane. A continuation carries `readViewId`, `publicationVectorDigest`, exact query projection, order, page boundary, authorization, policy, cutoff, and expiry; a mismatch refuses rather than follows current state.

`PublicationCurrentBindingView` is a non-material response projection with `securityPartitionId`, `publicationChannelId`, `publicationGeneration`, `publicationDecisionRef`, `publicationCandidateRef`, `publicationManifestRef`, `observedAt`, `observationCutoff`, and integrity/availability standing. It is absent when there is no proven current binding and never creates or changes one. It cannot satisfy, be referenced as, or replace the material `currentBindingObservation` inside a `ContentReadViewRecord`.

The seventeen operation/input pairings and public concurrency token remain unchanged. `AnalysisStatusRecord` may correlate `operationExecutionId`, durable target reference, state revision, and public concurrency token. It does not become a claim, work unit, attempt, candidate lifecycle, read lifecycle, cache entry, retention action, or migration execution.

### F.7 Operational health response and no-current standing

`HealthObservationView` is an immutable inline response projection, not a persisted operational-record role and not an acquired content or raw read view. Its closed fields are `viewKind: health-observation`, `scope`, `authorizationDecisionRef`, `policyRefs`, `healthSourceRefs`, `observationCutoff`, and `binding`. `binding` is exactly one of:

- `committed-publication-vector`, carrying an exact `PublicationVector` and `publicationVectorDigest`;
- `no-current-binding`, carrying only a source-owned safe reason;
- `binding-unavailable`, carrying only a source-owned safe reason and retry standing;
- `binding-corrupt`, carrying only a source-owned safe reason and safe `IntegrityIncidentRecord` reference.

Every non-content branch contains no publication or content reference and authorizes no semantic traversal. Bootstrap, restore, migration, recovery, corruption, and withdrawal standing are reported through `healthSourceRefs`, the binding branch's source-owned reason where applicable, and H01–H14; they are not additional binding discriminators. Subject and channel may be owner-backed `notApplicable(reason)` only where the operation policy permits it.

`HealthResponse` retains `providerExecutionHealth`, `capabilityCoverage`, `evidenceFreshness`, `findingState`, and `laterGateOutcome`, and adds `healthView` plus `operationalDimensions`. The latter is a closed object containing exactly H01 through H14. Each dimension is `OperationalHealthDimensionObservation { dimensionId, standing, observationCutoff, sourceRefs, omittedOrWithheldRegions, diagnosticRefs }` or typed `notApplicable(reason)`; `dimensionId` equals the containing field.

| Dimension | Name | Question answered |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `H01` | Process/component liveness | Can the bounded component respond under its declared probe? |
| `H02` | Read readiness | Can exact retained publications be served with authorization, integrity, and pinned views? |
| `H03` | Write/publication readiness | Can accepted work durably progress and atomically publish under current profile? |
| `H04` | Recovery readiness | Are incomplete intents, claims, migrations, retention actions, corruption, and audit gaps reconciled? |
| `H05` | Storage/material integrity | Do required immutable materials, collections, manifests, and current bindings validate? |
| `H06` | Security-control readiness | Are authentication, authorization, information control, encryption, keys, secrets, and audit enforceable? |
| `H07` | Dependency/provider execution health | Are exact declared dependencies/providers available within capability and qualification limits? |
| `H08` | Capability coverage | What supported, partial, unsupported, excluded, and not-analyzed regions exist? |
| `H09` | Evidence freshness/currentness | Which exact publications/evidence sets are current, stale, invalidated, unknown, or historical? |
| `H10` | Finding and conflict state | What technical findings, conflicts, disagreements, and unresolved treatments exist? |
| `H11` | Later gate outcome | Separate external gate dimension; currently no RGP exists |
| `H12` | Backlog/fairness/capacity | What admitted, queued, starved-risk, saturated, refused, and headroom states exist? |
| `H13` | Migration/backup/retention state | What cutover, restore, hold, deletion, and rollback risks remain? |
| `H14` | Observability/reconstructability | Are mandatory events, correlations, metrics, and safe diagnostics complete? |

No aggregate `healthy` Boolean is permitted. Liveness does not imply readiness; provider availability does not imply semantic completeness; freshness does not imply correctness; unknown or unobserved is not healthy. Absence of an effective RGP makes H11 and the existing `laterGateOutcome` reasoned `notApplicable`, never pass, fail, healthy, or satisfied.

### F.8 Twelve operational typed-error closures

Each row adds one exact stable code to the major-version registry. `safeDetails` is a closed code-discriminated object whose `kind` equals the full code. Every named field is required; alien fields are rejected. Protected values use authorized digests, safe references, or `withheld`, never secrets, host paths, unrestricted source, target existence, internal stacks, or unauthorized counts or shapes.

| Source gap | Exact stable code | Exact `safeDetails` fields |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-A007-ERR-GAP-001` | `CSAA-E-CONFIG-OPERATIONAL-CONTEXT-STALE` | `kind`, `operationalProfileInstantiationRef`, `configurationKind`, `expectedConfigurationDigest`, `observedConfigurationDigest`, `stalenessReason`, `requiredSuccessorKind` |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-A007-ERR-GAP-002` | `CSAA-E-PROVIDER-QUALIFICATION-NONPASS` | `kind`, `providerDeclarationRef`, `qualificationState(absent\|invalid\|expired\|incompatible)`, `qualificationRefOrWithheld`, `requiredQualificationPolicyRef`, `retryBoundary` |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-A007-ERR-GAP-003` | `CSAA-E-LIFECYCLE-OPERATIONAL-BASIS-UNRESOLVED` | `kind`, `basisKind(dependency\|invalidation-closure\|cache-entry\|cache-basis)`, `affectedBasisRefOrDigest`, `basisState(unresolved\|incomplete\|stale\|uncertain)`, `affectedRegionRefOrWithheld`, `requiredReconciliationKind` |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-A007-ERR-GAP-004` | `CSAA-E-PUBLICATION-GENERATION-CONFLICT` | `kind`, `publicationChannelIdOrWithheld`, `candidateLifecycleIdOrWithheld`, `expectedPredecessorRefOrNone`, `observedPredecessorRefOrWithheld`, `expectedPublicationGeneration`, `observedPublicationGenerationOrWithheld`, `conflictCutoff` |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-A007-ERR-GAP-005` | `CSAA-E-PUBLICATION-OUTCOME-UNKNOWN` | `kind`, `publicationChannelIdOrWithheld`, `candidateLifecycleIdOrWithheld`, `publicationIdempotencyKeyDigest`, `expectedPublicationGeneration`, `uncertaintyBoundary`, `reconciliationRefOrRequired` |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-A007-ERR-GAP-006` | `CSAA-E-INTEGRITY-MATERIAL-NONPASS` | `kind`, `integrityFailureKind(digest-collision\|corruption\|quarantined\|physical-format-incompatible)`, `affectedMaterialRefOrDigest`, `integrityIncidentRefOrRequired`, `containmentState`, `affectedRegionRefOrWithheld` |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-A007-ERR-GAP-007` | `CSAA-E-MIGRATION-EXECUTION-NONPASS` | `kind`, `migrationExecutionIdOrWithheld`, `migrationFailureKind(divergence\|backfill\|cutover\|fallback\|rollback)`, `sourceProfileRef`, `targetProfileRef`, `checkpointRefOrNotApplicable`, `residualState` |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-A007-ERR-GAP-008` | `CSAA-E-MATERIAL-LIFECYCLE-ACTION-NONPASS` | `kind`, `actionKind(retention\|deletion\|backup\|restore\|residual-copy)`, `actionRefOrDigest`, `policyRef`, `affectedMaterialClass`, `verificationState`, `residualCopyState` |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-A007-ERR-GAP-009` | `CSAA-E-SECURITY-CONTROL-NONPASS` | `kind`, `controlKind(encryption\|key\|certificate\|secret\|egress)`, `policyRef`, `controlRefOrWithheld`, `controlState`, `affectedPartitionIdOrWithheld`, `retryBoundary` |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-A007-ERR-GAP-010` | `CSAA-E-AUDIT-DURABILITY-FAILED` | `kind`, `evidenceKind(audit\|telemetry)`, `requiredEventClass`, `durabilityBoundary`, `correlationRefOrWithheld`, `reconstructabilityState`, `reconciliationRefOrRequired` |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-A007-ERR-GAP-011` | `CSAA-E-EXTERNAL-EFFECT-OUTCOME-UNKNOWN` | `kind`, `effectKind`, `effectIdempotencyKeyDigest`, `intentRef`, `targetSystemRefOrWithheld`, `observedStanding(unknown\|partially-completed)`, `reconciliationRefOrRequired` |
| `JAN-CSAA-009-A007-ERR-GAP-012` | `CSAA-E-ISOLATION-BASIS-MISMATCH` | `kind`, `mismatchKind(cross-partition\|time-of-check-time-of-use)`, `expectedPartitionIdOrDigest`, `observedPartitionIdOrDigestOrWithheld`, `expectedStateRevisionOrCutoff`, `observedStateRevisionOrCutoff`, `affectedOperationRefOrWithheld` |

These twelve codes bring the major-version stable registry from 65 to 77 codes. A gap identity is never serialized. The code does not grant retry, repair, authorization, publication, migration, deletion, restore, or execution permission. `CSAA-E-INTERNAL-UNEXPECTED` remains only an opaque fallback when no registered distinction is knowable and cannot erase a known gap.

### F.9 Closure, trace, compatibility, and nonperformance result

The operational extension is closed as follows:

| Surface | Exact population | Closure rule |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Operational Profile Definition | 1 definition with 30 ordered facets | O01–O30 exactly once; no punctuation parsing or defaults |
| Runtime operational records | 31 roles | Exact §F.3 order; one unique OEAR assignment each |
| Complete top-level operational assignments | 32 | OEAR-001 through OEAR-032, disjoint from 144 legacy assignments |
| Operational identities | 37 rows / 40 names | Every identity remains independently preserved |
| Projection coordinates | 12 | P01–P12 total; exact values or expressly permitted owner-backed not-applicable |
| Derived operational projections | 5 | Security partition, publication channel, candidate subject, operation key, cache key |
| Digest profiles | 5 | Record, projection, candidate, replay basis, replay completion |
| Operational target sets | 3 | Runtime, profile-definition, and their closed union |
| Reference aliases | 5 | Operational identity/content refs, two directional bridges, and exact migration-epoch content reference |
| Finalization directions | 6 | Predecessor, content, live correlation, publication, binding, replay |
| Canonical keys | 13 | Identity, content, projection-coordinate, health-dimension, typed reference, digest, named entry, publication lane, role-labelled reference, ordered assessment, compatibility pair, current physical binding, request-target publication channel |
| Self-excluding preimages | 3 | Candidate, replay basis, replay completion |
| Health dimensions | 14 | H01–H14 plus preserved five existing response axes |
| Operational error codes | 12 | One stable code and closed safe payload per 009 gap |
| Phase/digest negative allocations | 6 | Independently executable and reportable by affected 008 successor |

`ContractPackageManifestRecord` enumerates the legacy and operational registries separately and reports complete package totals without rewriting the preserved Appendix E proof. `SourceToContractTraceRecord` contains one row for `OperationalProfileDefinitionRecord`, one row for each of the 31 operational roles, one for every identity/projection/preimage, one for every health dimension, and one for every error mapping. Future generated parity must reproduce every field, discriminator, state reference, identity phase, projection, exclusion, collection key, reference direction, safe payload, and count.

This is a MAJOR contract successor. Directional compatibility with `0.1.0` is `incompatible` or `unknown` unless an exact map proves every required distinction; a legacy consumer cannot ignore, coerce, or invent an operational role. The legacy `PublicationManifestRecord` remains a `0.1.0` family shape and does not acquire lifecycle, content, decision, current-binding, or replay-completion semantics.

Every schema source is `NOT_CREATED / NOT_ENFORCED`; every generated derivative is `NOT_GENERATED / NOT_VERIFIED`; every operational profile instantiation is absent; every runtime record population is empty because no implementation execution occurred; every 008 case is `NOT_AUTHORIZED / NOT_MATERIALIZED / NOT_RUN`; every oracle is unconferred; every provider remains unqualified; and no storage, orchestration, topology, algorithm, policy value, numeric budget, gate, assurance, sponsor, recorder, or implementation authority is selected or conferred.
